card.title: A share is a slice of a company

body.claim: One share of stock means fractional ownership of the company.
body.why: A share typically entitles its holder to a matching fraction of the company's earnings, of what is left if assets are sold off after debts are paid, or of voting power. These are split in proportion to the shares each person owns. Not all stock is equal, though, because a company can issue different classes with different rules.

probes.question: What does a single share of stock represent?
True or false: all stock is always identical, whatever the class.

claims.claim: One share means fractional ownership of the company (probe 1)
claims.quote: A single share of the stock means fractional ownership of the corporation in proportion to the total number of shares.

claims.claim: Entitles holder to a fraction of earnings, liquidation proceeds or voting power
claims.quote: This typically entitles the shareholder (stockholder) to that fraction of the company's earnings

claims.claim: Divided in proportion to shares owned
claims.quote: in proportion to the number of like shares each stockholder owns

claims.claim: Not all stock is equal; classes differ (probe 2 false)
claims.quote: Not all stock is necessarily equal, as certain classes of stock may be issued
